Conventional Test Facility

Amentum is supporting the third phase of an advanced U.S. Navy test facility project, an effort that began over a decade ago and will continue for years to come. This large-scale initiative spans multiple engineering disciplines (process, mechanical, controls, software, structural), giving interns exposure to diverse aspects of engineering and hands-on work with hardware.

The software team drives all data acquisition and control room functionality. - Historian and data sharing across distributed operator consoles

The Meta Reality Labs Research Team brings together a world-class team of researchers, developers, and engineers to create the future of virtual and augmented reality, which together will become as universal and essential as smartphones and personal computers are today.

Reality Labs Research Audio builds the audio-visual perception that future smart glasses will rely on. That includes understanding who the wearer is talking to, who is speaking, and how a conversation is organized. To train and evaluate these models at scale, we need realistic conversation data that comes with exact ground truth. This internship explores generative models that produce such data.

The project:

Generate realistic video with audio of multi-person conversations. Inputs can be text alone, text plus one image of a group, or text plus a reference image for each person. Beyond looking real, the scenes should show natural social interaction: turn-taking, gaze, head orientation, listener reactions and group formations. Each scene should also be controllable: the 3D position of each person, how people are grouped, and the position and pose of the egocentric camera. That control is what lets the output serve as accurately labelled training data for audio-visual models, e.g. predicting the glasses wearer's intent or detecting conversation groups.

Responsibilities

Design and train video diffusion or flow-matching models for multi-person conversation scenes, generating audio and video together. Develop ways to condition generation on 3D layout, group structure and egocentric camera trajectory. Keep each person's identity consistent across frames and viewpoints, from one or several reference images. Model natural conversational behavior: speech-driven faces and gestures, gaze, turn-taking and listener reactions. Build evaluations for realism, audio-visual sync, identity consistency, and how closely the generated 3D positions and poses match the specified ones. Use the generated data to train downstream egocentric perception models, and measure how much it helps. Publish results at top venues together with Meta researchers.

Qualifications

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining, a PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning or a related field Research experience in generative modeling for video or images, with first-author publications at venues such as CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICLR or SIGGRAPH Hands-on experience training or fine-tuning modern video diffusion or flow-matching models (e.g. DiT-based architectures), including conditioning methods such as adapters, ControlNet or LoRA Experience with controllable generation from geometric or structural signals: camera pose, 3D layout, depth or human pose Solid grounding in 3D vision: camera models, multi-view geometry and coordinate transforms 3+ years experience with Python, Matlab, Pytorch, large-scale distributed GPU training or similar Must obtain work authorization in the country of employment at the time of hire, and maintain ongoing work authorization during employment Experience with joint audio-video generation, speech-driven talking heads or gestures, multi-speaker TTS, or lip sync Background in spatial audio: binaural rendering, HRTFs, or room acoustics simulation Research on modeling social interaction: conversational dynamics, gaze, turn-taking or group formations Familiarity with egocentric perception and datasets (e.g. Ego4D, Ego-Exo4D, Aria), and with tasks such as active speaker detection or conversation grouping Experience with 3D or 4D human and scene representations (e.g. SMPL-X, Gaussian splatting, NeRF) or multi-view-consistent video generation Experience with synthetic data generation, game
